The submission is complete and validated.

## What was built (`/app/submit`)

| file | role |
|---|---|
| `run` (755) | self-contained launcher; compiles `core.c` on first use (`cc`/`gcc`, into `<submit>/build` or `$TMPDIR`, self-checks the `.so` with `ctypes`, falls back to a pure-Python DP if no compiler), then runs `main.py` |
| `core.c` | exact placement core: per-depth node/edge grouping, the `align_64/8` cost formula, a full `U[b][e]` table and an exact bottleneck DP over cut sequences (`max_i U[i]/cap[i]` compared with `unsigned __int128` rational cross-multiplication) |
| `main.py` | strict request guard, IPv6 hex codec, compile, image validation, lookup |

## Key design points

- **Layout is fully determined by the FIB** exactly as specified (root at stage 0, one node per distinct `trunc(p,b)` with `len(p)>b`, rules sorted by `(len,net)`, edges by `trunc(p,e)`, `/0` rule only in the root).
- **Optimality is exact**: the DP minimises the rational peak with no floating point; feasibility (`U[i] â¤ cap[i]`, strides â¤ `max_stride`) is enforced, so genuinely unplaceable FIBs return `{"status":"infeasible"}`.
- **Guard rails for hostile lines**: duplicate-key hook, depth â¥ 40 and value-count caps computed on string-stripped bytes (C-speed, linear), so 32 MiB bombs (`[[[[â¦`, `[1,1,â¦`, giant strings) are rejected in milliseconds without losing the stream.
- **Lookup images are re-derived, not trusted**: every prefix must be canonically serialised, and the collected rules are re-run through the canonical layout builder and compared node-by-node, rule-by-rule, edge-by-edge, plus `used_bits`/`peak` recomputation â catching wrong accounting, misplaced/duplicate rules, bad children and non-canonical strings.

## Verification

- `python3 /app/public_sanity.py` â passes.
- **Optimality**: 250+ random FIBs (0â2048 rules, Sâ{4â¦16}, varied capacities/strides) checked against an independently written reference DP built straight from the task text â all optimal, layouts byte-identical.
- **Lookup**: thousands of queries verified against an independent LPM, including images with foreign cut sequences and mutated images.
- **Rejection**: 93 hand-built malformed/edge requests (duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity, bools-as-ints, out-of-range hops/caps, non-canonical prefixes, dotted-decimal, zones, 2049 rules, 20001 addresses, deep nesting, megabyte value counts) â all exactly `{"status":"invalid"}` with stream recovery.
- **Resources**: 195 mixed requests/1.4 s; max-size image (28 899 nodes, 3.4 MB) compiles in 0.5 s; 20 000-address lookup 1.4 s; 13.9 MB aggregate workload 5.7 s; five 32 MiB adversarial lines in 3.2 s; works with a read-only submission directory.
